messages.subject: Most active time during a day for vigorous physical acitvity

Hello everyone,

is there a way to create output indicating during which time of the day the most vigorous physical activity was performed, just like M5TIME_num_pla?

Thank you for your answers in advance!

Best regards

Fabian

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Most active time during a day for vigorous physical acitvity
parts:
Hi Fabian,

This is not implemented yet. However, GGIR part 5 can store the detected behavioural classes, including MVPA bouts, from which you can derive those estimates yourself.

However, I am happy to help automate this and integrate it in GGIR as part of a paid consultancy.

Best regards,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees
Independent consultant
https://accelting.com/
